commonEntryCondition.selectedHost: SettingsPage reads selectedHostId; second visibility argument is descriptor.kind === local, not a product-mode flag.

visibilityComposition.earlyFilter: If !(a || Ca.includes(slug)), visible/pending/error are all false.

routeSelection.X: Matching requested section after the cloud-settings alias handling; these three sections do not use that alias.

conditions.accessFamily: chatGptOrCodex = x || m; selectors represent access, not exclusive product identity.

conditions.mode: unknown; keep the outer error/pending behavior rather than equating this visibility formula with every possible mount.
